chunks: 1798 - And Jamīl ibn Darrāj narrated from him, عليه السلام, that he said:
"Whoever enters upon his brother while he is fasting, then breaks his fast with him and does not inform him of his fasting, lest he show favor to him, Allah will write for him the fasting of a year."

key_terms.صَوْمَ سَنَةٍ: the reward of fasting for a full year
key_terms.فَيَمُنَّ: so that he would not impose a favor or remind him of it

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for breaking a recommended fast at a believer's home without telling him?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the virtue of concealing one's voluntary fast when visiting a fellow believer and accepting his hospitality without seeking distinction or imposing a sense of obligation. It highlights sincerity, brotherhood, and the great reward Allah grants for preserving social harmony and humility.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1798 - It is narrated by Jamil ibn Darraj from Abu Abdullah (as) that Imam (as) said:
"Whoever visits his brother while fasting, then breaks his fast at his house without informing him of his fasting to gain favor, Allah (swt) will write for him the reward of fasting a full year."
